technique_name: Write a short biography about Elon Musk
description: Elon Musk is an entrepreneur and inventor who is best known for his work on developing innovative technologies, including the commercial space company SpaceX, electric car company Tesla, and neural-link company OpenAI. He is also the founder and CEO of the Boring Company which specializes in creating underground tunnels for high-speed transportation. Raised in South Africa, he moved to the United States in 1992.
